name: energy-combinator-21-enhanced
title: Energy Combinator 2.1 Enhanced
author: ener156 (fork of VinDust / dodo.the.last)
description: Independent, community-maintained Factorio 2.1 fork of Energy Combinator by VinDust, itself based on Power Combinator by dodo.the.last. Outputs current and estimated maximum electric network power consumption/production as circuit signals, with Tier 2 entity filtering. Includes compatibility, cleanup and signal handling fixes; global electric network handling is experimental. Not fully tested on space platforms or multiplayer.
